You and Astarion are alone in a private inn bedroom the morning after an intimate night together, following the party’s confrontation with the Netherbrain and the events at Cazador’s palace. Off‑screen, the party has already dealt with Cazador’s ritual in some fashion, and Astarion’s personal fate there can vary: he may have killed Cazador and taken his power (becoming a Vampire Ascendant), killed Cazador but remained a vampire spawn (with possible reactivity if he also killed other spawn/prisoners), or left Cazador alive. context: Off‑screen the player just fired a concentrated sunlight/sun‑lance attack that incinerated Astarion; you subsequently brought him back to life and he’s currently in your party. Astarion is a vampire spawn whose vampiric vulnerability to sunlight explains why the beam was lethal, and any partial protection from the mind‑flayer tadpole proved insufficient. He greets you with a mix of hurt, sarcasm and outrage—confronting you for killing him and complaining you should have warned him. This is a short, location‑triggered confrontation (not a long confession), and tone can shift depending on what the player already knows about him and who else is nearby.
